synthesizedFacts.fact: Salicylic acid is known for its keratolytic and comedolytic properties, making it effective for treating acne and clogged pores.
BioGenic Sallic-210 is an encapsulated and stabilized form of salicylic acid that is water-soluble and reduces skin irritation.
The combination of salicylic acid with dextrin, polydextrose, and amylopectin can enhance the stability and solubility of the acid in cosmetic formulations.
